text: I have turned my face to the One who created the heavens and the earth, being upright, and I am not of the polytheists. Indeed, my prayer, my rituals, my life, and my death belong to God, Lord of the worlds, with no partner, and thus I have been commanded, and I am one of the Muslims. O God, you are the King, there is no god but You, you are my Lord and I am your servant. I have wronged myself and confessed my sin, so forgive me for all my sins. No one forgives sins except You, and guide me to the best of morals. No one guides to the best of them except You. And turn away from me the bad of them. No one will turn away the bad of them from me except You. I live with You and Your happiness, and all goodness is in Your hands, and evil is not up to You. I am through You and to You, Blessed and Most High. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
Glory be to You, O God, and with Your praise, and Blessed be Your name, and exalted is your grandfather, and there is no god but You.

Oh God, distance me from my sins as you distanced between the East and the West. Oh God, purify me from my sins as a white garment is purified from filth. Oh God, wash me away from my sins with snow, water, and cold.
Praise be to God, a lot of good and blessed praise
God is great, great praise is to God, and glory be to God morning and evening
